name: phasekit
description: phasekit's guardrails and subagents for Claude Code: the command guard, the stop-without-verdict hook, the wrap-up nudge, the compaction re-anchor, and the phase-gated workflow's agents. Active only in a pinned phasekit project (.phasekit-version) and under the phasekit loop; its hooks are inert in any other repository (its phasekit:* agents are listed everywhere it is installed), and it steps aside in a vendored project whose own .claude/settings.json wires the same hooks.
